shared_elements: curving bands or lines on/near the figure
justification: The strongest shared content is that both include an anthropomorphic figure associated with repeated sign-like motifs and some circular/curving forms. The biggest difference is that A shows a detailed profile standing figure flanked by dense columns of discrete signs, while B shows a single frontal, highly schematic body-like form with a few signs and simple circular/linear motifs placed on the figure itself.
